title: 71. How do I adjust the default confirmation message?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: How do I adjust the default confirmation message.
short_answer: The confirmation message is what participants see when they have submitted their contribution. To change the default message, open the survey, go to the 'Properties' page and change the confirmation message under 'Special Pages'. If you have already published your survey, please remember to go to the 'Overview' page and click on 'Apply Changes'.
